title: the red proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_tester_is_reached_only_through_its_interface.py reseals green
intention: cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_tester_is_reached_only_through_its_interface.py reseals green, so the red the tester found is not lost.
why: Outline 9.4.2.3.7.5 (reds don't get lost): the tester measured it. cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_tester_is_reached_only_through_its_interface.py ran red; teeth red: test_no_foreign_row_lands_on_the_tester, test_the_tester_is_reached_only_through_its_interface.
traces_to: Law 7 (errors are permanent in records of truth); outline 9.4.2.3.7.5
how: The red is a RULE 1 breach, not the tester's: cairn/devices/db_domain/proofs/test_the_scratch_proof_declares_a_budget_above_its_wall.py:25/30 (cf32e6f141e0's proof, landed 8cb66e560) imports cairn.devices.tester.device.declared_timeout and TesterDevice. Rewrite that proof to reach the tester only through its public interface: clause 1 reads PROOF_TIMEOUT_S from the subject by AST (the reading declared_timeout does), clause 2 runs `bin/cairn test --timeout 2` over a fixture sleeping 5 s that declares the subject's value (green), with controls undeclared and declared-below-the-sleep (both not green). The intention cf32 PROVED shows is unchanged: the scratch proof declares 300 and a declared budget outranks the caller's. Seal the edited proof under --ruling 4cc2775efeff.

measured.saw: encapsulation_breaches names cairn/devices/db_domain/proofs/test_the_scratch_proof_declares_a_budget_above_its_wall.py:25 and :30 importing cairn.devices.tester.device; with the rewrite in place the tester proof reads green and cairn/devices/db_domain/proofs/test_the_scratch_proof_declares_a_budget_above_its_wall.py reads green in 27 s
